statement: The recorded value ("water into acid") is **unsafe and incorrect** for diluting concentrated sulfuric acid — adding water to concentrated acid can cause violent boiling and splattering of hot acid. The safe practice is always to add acid to water. I will therefore run the step with the corrected, safe value.
